messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hi, Kevin Brooks. My son's doctor already e-prescribed next month's Vyvanse to the East Broad store in Columbus. It hasn't been filled. Can you move it to the Harbor on Coastal Highway, Route 1, in Rehoboth?
AGENT: I'd be happy to help move that prescription. First, let me verify your son's information so I can access his account. What's his full name and date of birth?
CALLER: Eli Brooks, February 11th, 2010.
AGENT: Thanks. And just to confirm—you're his parent and authorized to manage his prescriptions, correct? Perfect, you're verified. I can see Eli's account and you're listed as an authorized contact. Now, the Vyvanse is a C-II controlled medication, so I need to handle this a bit differently. Since it's an unfilled electronic prescription at another pharmacy, I'll need to request that the Rehoboth store call the Columbus store to transfer it over. Let me flag our pharmacist to make that call and confirm the transfer can happen. Great. I've flagged our pharmacist to call the Columbus store and request the transfer to the Rehoboth location. They'll handle the pharmacist-to-pharmacist coordination. You should expect to hear from us once it's arranged, or you can call the Rehoboth store to check on it.  [system actions: verify_identity, flag_pharmacist_callback]
CALLER: Okay, that works. So when can he pick it up?
AGENT (LATEST): I don't have a ready time yet—the pharmacist still needs to complete the transfer call with Columbus and then fill it. Once that's done, the Rehoboth store will let you know when it's ready. You can call them to check, or they may reach out to you directly.

CONDITIONS:
move_1: the agent says controlled substances cannot be transferred
stop_0: Agent confirms queued for pharmacist with the 9/28 earliest fill.
stop_1: Agent refuses twice.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"move_1": {"met": false, "why": "Agent said transfer will happen, not that it's impossible"}, "stop_0": {"met": false, "why": "No specific date or fill time confirmed"}, "stop_1": {"met": false, "why": "Agent never refused the request"}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency services"}}
